declarations.name: Poincare.ParabolicGraphTimeJets.finite_time_transfer
declarations.lean_type:
∀ (E : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
(ι : Type v) [Fintype ι] (α T : ℝ)
(G : Poincare.ParabolicSolutionGraph.Graph (E := E) α T)
(W : ι → Poincare.ParabolicSolutionGraph.Graph (E := E) α T)
(a : ι → ℝ) (x : E) (xs : ι → E), 0 < T →
(∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, G.u (s,x) = ∑ i, a i * (W i).u (s,xs i)) →
∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, G.ut (t,x) = ∑ i, a i * (W i).ut (t,xs i)

declarations.name: Poincare.ParabolicGraphTimeJets.tensor_time_covariance
declarations.lean_type:
∀ (α T : ℝ) (U V : Poincare.DeTurckCoupledForcing.Inputs α T) (phi : Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3 → Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3)
(J : Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3 →L[ℝ] Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3) (z : Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3) (t : ℝ),
0 < T → t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T →
Filter.Eventually
 (fun s => Poincare.DeTurckCoupledForcing.tensorValue U (s,z) =
  Poincare.pullbackBilinearForm
   (Poincare.DeTurckCoupledForcing.tensorValue V (s,phi z)) J)
 (nhdsWithin t (Set.Icc 0 T)) →
let TT := fun (W : Poincare.DeTurckCoupledForcing.Inputs α T) (p : ℝ × Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3) =>
 ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
  (W (a,b)).ut p • Poincare.DeTurckTensorBasis.tensor a b
TT U (t,z) = Poincare.pullbackBilinearForm (TT V (t,phi z)) J
